description: This PHP script is a test client for uploading attachments to a TestLink API via XML-RPC. It reads an image file, encodes it in Base64, and sends it as part of a test case attachment upload using the IXR_Client class for communication.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used as an XML-RPC client for making remote procedure calls to the TestLink server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function to execute the test call to the server with specified method and arguments.
